title: VUA packages-catalog command v0.2
description: The packages package-catalog read-face command (proposal 025 P2 freeze batch 2026-09-17; stance program converged: environment proposal 64bfe58, integration stances 7a50ce9, desktop stance 0031004, core rulings bf78368). v0.2 carries exactly one method, packages.packageCatalog: the on-demand per-package catalog facts for ONE package viewed in ONE registered project's context. The COMMAND face is byte-for-byte the frozen v0.1 command face (proposal 025 inline ruling 2026-09-17: the v0.2 increment versions the RESULT family only — the two-key closed params set, granularity ruling, error codes, and identity semantics are unchanged and remain governed by the v0.1 freeze text). Granularity ruling: per-query on demand — there is deliberately NO full-catalog projection and NO pagination semantics (thousands-scale caches never ride this face; a consumer wanting more packages issues more queries). projectPath is the same registered-path identity the proposal-013 read face and the P1 packages.listInstalled face use; an unregistered path answers the REUSED typed not-found vua.project.project_not_found. packageId selects the catalog subject; a package present in neither the repository caches nor the local package set answers the REUSED typed vua.vpm.no_matching_package, which the consumer renders as its own empty state, not an error page (desktop stance). compatible judgments are bound to the selected project's Unity version (never a cross-project assertion); prerelease inclusion follows the user's show_prerelease_packages setting — a server-side behavior with NO wire switch (no invented preference field). Write faces (install/update/remove) do not exist in this family: read-only by design, writes follow the proposal-013 R5 per-face independent-proposal path.

projectPath.description: The registered project path (proposal-013 identity). The compatible judgment context: never a cross-project assertion.

packageId.description: The VPM package identifier (the manifest name) whose catalog facts are queried. Exactly these two keys are accepted; any extra key is a vua.packages.invalid_params shape violation, never a default.
